content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "Yes: the judge text evaluates the pressed Luke 2:48-49 witness by local qualification rather than by weighing the competing chains by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "\"never verse by verse\": one reading is that the judge must resolve this collision only by chain-against-chain footing; the other is that a local verse-level qualification can dispose of the challenge if the verse is underdetermined.", "why": "The judge's stated reason resolves the Luke 2:48-49 challenge by immediately qualifying one phrase within the verse, which is the verse-by-verse mode K-C forbids when the witnesses are the pressing side's own chain."}
